query:
update directory_sync_config set
                ldap_url = $1,
                bind_dn = $2,
                bind_password_encrypted = coalesce($3, bind_password_encrypted),
                bind_password_nonce = coalesce($4, bind_password_nonce),
                require_starttls = $5,
                base_dn = $6,
                user_filter = $7,
                attribute_mapping = $8
            where organization_id = 1
